role_title: Senior Software Engineer: CI/CD & Cloud Automation Lead
expected_jd_text:
Job summary
Kasmo Global is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to work with State Street in a hybrid role based in Princeton, NJ. The ideal candidate will have over 10 years of experience in software development, emphasizing Python and CI/CD pipelines. Responsibilities include creating scripts for SonarQube integration and managing cloud releases. Candidates should possess excellent communication skills and the ability to work across multiple teams. This contract lasts for 3 months, extendable up to 12 months at a competitive rate.

Qualifications
10+ years as a developer.
Excellent knowledge of Python and CI/CD pipelines.
Good knowledge of Git, SonarQube, Databricks/Datalake/RDBMS, Jenkins.
Excellent communication skills.
Self-motivated and driven.
Responsibilities
Work with multiple platforms to understand CI/CD pipelines.
Create scripts to support SonarQube rollout and integrate with datalake.
Research and manage releases in line with policies.
Write standards and documentation for these processes.
